Welcome to my blog! This is where I'll be sharing my thoughts and explorations on AI models.

## What to Expect

I'll be covering topics such as:

- **Large Language Models**: Deep dives into architectures like Transformers, attention mechanisms, and the latest developments in LLMs
- **Model Training**: Techniques for fine-tuning, RLHF, and efficient training strategies
- **AI Applications**: Practical guides on using AI models for real-world problems
- **Research Summaries**: Breakdowns of interesting papers from arXiv and top conferences

## Stay Tuned

More posts coming soon! Feel free to check out the [About](../../about.qmd) page to learn more about this blog.
